items.summary: Handoff: continue bounded read-only security evidence capture and failed-work containment. Public exposure and security-sensitive releases remain blocked because fleet-doctor, operations, and material control evidence are unavailable.

Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Concrete evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication boundaries, least privilege, secrets handling, container isolation, release provenance and approvals, dependency and supply-chain controls, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, complete TLS posture, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS coverage. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 35 pass, 14 fail, and 10 unknown. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Risk severity is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, medium for bounded growth. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates and permit only bounded reversible growth that does not add credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, cross-site behavior, or rights-dependent exposure.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix and failed-work containment only. Record dated evidence, owners, affected scope, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications for access boundaries, secrets, runtime isolation, release provenance, dependency controls, TLS, data flows, monitoring, incident readiness, and disclosure readiness. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, modify permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue failures, or conduct external outreach.

Continue bounded read-only security evidence capture and failed-work containment using existing metadata and retained artifacts only. Public exposure and security-sensitive releases remain blocked while material controls are unevidenced.
